prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: town square paving of medium flat flagstones: irregular rectangular grey-beige slabs of varied sizes (about 12-20 art pixels across) in staggered rows, thin dark joints, worn edges, small cracks, a little moss. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map, filling the entire image edge to edge. Town square paving made of medium, flat, irregular rectangular grey-beige flagstone slabs, approximately 12–20 logical art pixels wide, staggered rows, varied sizes, thin dark joints, worn edges, sparse small cracks and little bits of moss. Seamlessly repeatable: stone and joint patterns at the left/right boundaries match and at the top/bottom boundaries match. Consistent moderate detail with no focal features. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, clean hand-placed square pixels, each logical art pixel a uniformly sized crisp square approximately 7–8 display pixels wide. No antialiasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no random noise or checkerboard dithering. Coherent shaped clusters of 3–10 pixels, 4–6 shades per material, hue-shifted earthy palette: more saturated purple-reddish shadows, warm yellow highlights. Classic top-down orthographic RPG view, flat surface only, no perspective convergence. Neutral soft even upper-left illumination as a clean base texture, NO cast shadows, night darkness, light sources, glow, lamp pools or vignette. NO border, frame, objects, characters or text.
